terra.problem: Saying Jesus' compassion is the heart behind everything that comes next assigns a reason beyond what the passage states.
Papa says he wandered around the junk drawer for years, contradicting his backstory of lying at the back of the drawer.
The next verse mentions a harvest, but it does not say a field shows up.
Calling all twelve disciples ordinary adds a description the passage does not give.
The cookie-box label comparison is a flat, generic observation rather than a distinctive Papa Dorin moment.
The claim that fishermen are among the apostles comes from outside this passage and needs a reference. The phrase 'fish story' also has a well-known second meaning.
The explanation is flat and generic; noting that there are no tents adds little personality.
Saying the heavy ending is meant to be heavy guesses at the writer's intent, which the text does not state.
